description: Permanently delete a variant from a draft campaign or sequence A/B test. This cannot be undone. Variant A is the control and cannot be deleted, and the test must keep at least the minimum number of variants. Variants cannot be removed after the test has started. Sequence tests whose parent sequence is active require confirmLiveChange.

companyId.description: Company ID. If not provided, uses the currently selected company.

confirmLiveChange.description: Required as true when the A/B test belongs to an active sequence, because deletion immediately changes the live rotation.

variantId.description: A/B test variant ID to delete.

name: delete_ab_test_variant

outputSchema.description: Structured content returned by the `delete_ab_test_variant` MCP tool.

abTest.description: The A/B test record returned by Sequenzy.

items.description: Fallback array wrapper used only when a tool returns a bare array.

message.description: Human-readable status, confirmation, or next-step message.

value.description: Fallback object wrapper used only when a tool returns a non-object value.

warnings.description: Non-fatal cautions about content, permissions, or follow-up actions.
